# Leon Nelson — Full-Stack Software Engineer & Digital Strategist

> Official portfolio, technical documentation, and service directory for Leon Nelson, specializing in high-performance web applications, cloud DevOps infrastructure, and data-driven SEO growth architecture.

## Overview
Leon Nelson is a Nairobi-based Software Engineer and Digital Marketer engineering scalable digital solutions for high-growth enterprises and ambitious startups globally.

## Core Capabilities
- [Full-Stack Web Development](https://leonshireku.me/#services): Production-ready web applications using React, Next.js, Node.js, and modern APIs.
- [DevOps & Cloud Engineering](https://leonshireku.me/#services): CI/CD automation, Docker containerization, and cloud infrastructure reliability.
- [SEO & Technical Optimization](https://leonshireku.me/#services): Data-driven search engine optimization, Core Web Vitals, and organic conversion funnels.
- [Social Media Management](https://leonshireku.me/#services): Brand positioning, audience engagement, and multi-channel content strategy.

## Featured Projects
